name: prompt-setup-place-ussr
description: Setup: the USSR (you) places 6 influence in Eastern Europe; 2 placed already.

name: prompt-setup-place-us
description: Setup: the US (you) places 7 influence in Western Europe, after the USSR's setup.

name: prompt-bid-place
description: The US bid: +2 influence where the US already has influence.

name: prompt-headline-t1
description: Turn 1 headline: choose a card from the opening hand.

name: prompt-headline
description: A later headline (turn 4+: Mid War cards in hand).

name: prompt-action-card
description: Choose the card for an action round (turn 2+).

description: Choose a card while holding the playable China Card.

name: prompt-action-card-warning
description: Choose a card where some options carry warnings (scoring stranded / opponent event).

name: prompt-play-mode
description: How to play your own card: Event / Space / Influence / Coup / Realign.

name: prompt-play-mode-opponent
description: How to play an opponent's card (its event fires for the opponent if played for Ops).

name: prompt-op-mode
description: Deferred Ops: Influence / Coup / Realign.

name: prompt-influence
description: Placing Ops influence mid-run (some points placed already), turn 2+.

name: prompt-influence-start
description: Placing Ops influence: the first point of the run.

name: prompt-coup-target
description: Pick the coup target (coup odds per target in previews).

name: prompt-realign-target
description: Pick a realignment target (one roll per click).

name: prompt-event-target-add
description: An event places influence (a click adds a point).

name: prompt-event-target-remove
description: An event removes influence (a click removes a point).

name: prompt-event-target-other
description: An event targets a country without placing or removing (e.g. an event coup).

name: prompt-event-card
description: An event asks for a card (discard, give, retrieve...).

name: prompt-branch
description: An event branch choice (Warsaw Pact, Olympic Games, Wargames...).

name: prompt-defcon-level
description: Choose a DEFCON level (Summit / How I Learned to Stop Worrying).

name: prompt-region
description: Chernobyl: choose a region.

name: prompt-action-card-us
description: Choose the card for an action round, you are the US (turn 3+).

name: prompt-influence-us
description: Placing Ops influence mid-run, you are the US.

name: prompt-coup-target-us
description: Pick the coup target, you are the US (coup odds in previews).

name: prompt-midgame
description: Mid-game board (turn 5-7) at an action-card prompt, with the whole log.

name: seq-opening-ussr
description: Game start to the first headline prompt, you are the USSR: setup placements of both sides and the US bid.

name: seq-opening-us
description: Game start to the first headline prompt, you are the US: setup placements of both sides and the US bid.

name: seq-headline
description: Turn 1 headline: both choose, the papers reveal, both events resolve, AR 1 begins.

name: seq-ai-turn
description: An AI action round: the AI plays a card for influence, then your next prompt.

name: seq-ai-event

description: Frames around the first card played as "realign" (turn 2).

name: seq-play-discard
description: Frames around the first card played as "discard" (turn 4).

name: seq-over-defcon
description: The last frames of a game that ends by "defcon" (turn 4, US).

name: seq-over-held-scoring

description: The last frames of a game that ends by "milops-vp20" (turn 8, USSR).

name: seq-over-resign

name: seq-over-vp20
